key_findings.no_separate_equip_message: Confirmed by exhaustive search. Event_NetOut_EquipItem and Event_NetOut_UnequipItem do not exist. All equip/unequip is moveItem (method 38).
key_findings.container_id_range: 1-20; containers 4-14 are equipment slots; 3 = bandolier (4 slots); 1 = main bag (40 slots); 2 = mission bag (100 slots)
key_findings.bandolier_wire_indexing: Wire slot IDs are 1-indexed (C->S and S->C); server converts with saturating_sub(1) to 0-indexed; confirmed by Bag.py:369 comment in weapon-ammo-pipeline.md and FUN_00c74d20 calling EmitNetOut_RequestActiveSlotChange with raw SlotNum

rust_issues.description: Right-click equip-with-swap puts swapped-out item into inconsistent slot
rust_issues.root_cause: Binary confirms both items must be resolved in a single transaction. The swap logic is server-side in crates/services/src/base/world_entry/methods/inventory/move_/mod.rs. The occupant-swap path may not correctly handle the case where the source was an equipment slot (swap should go to INV_MAIN, not back to the equipment source slot).
rust_issues.recommended_fix: Audit occupant swap logic: if src_container is an equipment slot (4-14), the displaced occupant should go to INV_MAIN (container 1), not back to src_container.
